$description: Qualent design tokens. DTCG (W3C Design Tokens) format. DTCG has no native modes, so colour modes are sibling groups color.dark / color.light. $extensions.com.7gence.status: 'extracted' = taken from the ROI-Maxi Ember source (path in 'source'); 'proposed' = new in this system; 'changed' = extracted but altered (reason in $description). CSS twin: design/theme.css. Rationale: docs/design/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md.

brand.$description: Tenant hook. Defaults = Ember. Items marked critical must be resolved server-side per tenant (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md section 9).

base.$description: Raw tenant colour. Logo, glow, tints, chart-1.

on-solid.$description: critical. Label on the primary fill: 8.05:1 / 4.65:1 across the gradient. Ember used #ffffff (2.34 / 4.04:1, fails AA). Opinion; alternative in component.button.primary-alt.

text-dark.$description: critical. Brand text + focus ring on dark. 8.52:1 on panel.

text-light.$description: critical. Brand text + focus ring on light. 5.49:1 on light panel.

glow.$description: CSS derives it from brand.base with color-mix.

line.$description: Decorative hairline (1.13:1). Not subject to WCAG 1.4.11.

line-control.$description: Input/checkbox/toggle-off boundary. 3.24:1 on panel. Ember used 0.09 (1.21:1).

fg-muted.$description: 5.44:1 panel, 5.28:1 card. Absorbs FAINT #8a817c and DIM #7f7772 (DIM 4.40:1 on card fails).

fg-disabled.$description: Disabled only (exempt). Was used for live labels at 2.73:1.

lead.$description: Lead temperature. Pinned: never follows the tenant brand.

chart.$description: Categorical series, each >=3:1 on panel. Proposed order.

1.$description: Resolved brand text, not raw brand: >=8.9:1 for any tenant.

light.$description: Proposed. Ember was dark-only (app/layout.tsx:34 hardcodes class 'dark'). Warm paper neutrals mirror the warm-black ramp.

sans.$description: Geist kept; Inter dropped (it is loaded in app/layout.tsx:5 but only a fallback); Arabic added.

arabic.$description: Static weights 100-700 on Google Fonts; load 400/500/600/700.

size.$description: rem at 16px root. Collapses 22 px sizes used in components/ember (9.5-34) to 10. 11px floor.

input-mobile.$description: Inputs on touch devices: >=16px stops iOS zoom-on-focus.

arabic.$description: All tracking is 0 under :lang(ar): spacing breaks letter joins.

full.$description: Pills: buttons, chips, inputs, toggles (126 uses).

dense.$description: 10px table rows, menu items, dense inputs (new)

component.$description: Dimensions per component; colours come from the semantic tier (CSS var names in brackets).

primary-alt.$description: Alternative if white labels are wanted: darker gradient. 4.63:1 / 6.49:1 with #ffffff.

radius.$description: Pill for single-line; radius.card for textarea

gradient.$description: CSS values, because they mix with the client's brand colour at runtime. Twin of design/theme.css.
